claim: Mapping pages into slot 0 with interrupts on risks a crash (the IM1 vector at 0x38), and code running in slot 0 cannot unmap slot 0.

evidence.text: Maintainers' note on slot 0 paging; not checked against a source file.
Pages mapped into slot 0 while interrupts are on are a crash risk (IM1 vector at 0x38); DI around hook paging. Code running in slot 0 cannot unmap slot 0: map and unmap from alt ROM stubs.
evidence.quote: Pages mapped into slot 0 while interrupts are on = crash risk
